## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 353 captures during July 2024. This activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine service delivery. The volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. No new equipment faults were raised by staff during this reporting period.

## Image quality

There were 14 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 4.0. This result should continue to be monitored through routine quality review. The clinic can use these findings to identify any recurring issues affecting image acquisition and to support consistent capture practice.

## Grading

A total of 92 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 8 days. These results provide an overview of the month’s grading workload and turnaround. Continued review of referable outcomes and grading lag will support oversight of the service and help identify any emerging operational pressures.
